metadata.question: There was a volcanic plume visible over Mount Etna at 1:37 am local time on February 23, 2021. Did the plume go to the western side?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Mount Etna is in Sicily, Italy (~37.75°N, 15.00°E) - Local time 1:37 am on Feb 23, 2021 needs conversion to UTC (Italy is UTC+1 in winter) - 1:37 am local = 0:37 am UTC = Feb 23, 2021 00:37 UTC - Need satellite data that captures volcanic plumes (SO2, aerosols, or thermal anomalies) - GOES, MODIS, or Sentinel-5P for plume detection - Sentinel-5P has SO2 data which is excellent for volcanic plumes - Need to look at the spatial distribution of SO2 to determine direction 2. Masking strategy: - This is about detecting a plume, not masking it - Look for elevated SO2 or thermal signatures - Check the spatial distribution relative to the volcano location 3. Logic to distinguish: - C1: No satellite data available at that specific time - C2: Data exists but no valid pixels (unlikely for Sentinel-5P) - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - A: Plume extends to the west (western pixels have elevated values) - B: Plume does not extend to the west (goes other directions or no plume detected) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions etna = ee.Geometry.Point([15.00, 37.75]) target_date = '2021-02-23' # Create regions: west and east of the volcano west_region = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[14.85, 37.65], [14.85, 37.85], [15.00, 37.85], [15.00, 37.65], [14.85, 37.65]] ]) east_region = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[15.00, 37.65], [15.00, 37.85], [15.15, 37.85], [15.15, 37.65], [15.00, 37.65]] ]) # 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-5P SO2 col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_SO2') \ .filterDate(target_date, '2021-02-24') \ .filterBounds(etna) print(f"Images found: {col.size().getInfo()}") if col.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No Sentinel-5P data for this date.") print("C1") else: # 3. Get SO2 data img = col.first() so2_band = img.select('SO2_column_number_density') # 4. Calculate mean SO2 in west and east regions west_stats = so2_band.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=west_region, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo() east_stats = so2_band.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=east_region, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo() # Check pixel counts west_count = so2_band.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=west_region, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo() east_count = so2_band.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=east_region, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo() print(f"West SO2: {west_stats}, Pixels: {west_count}") print(f"East SO2: {east_stats}, Pixels: {east_count}") # 5. Validation & Answer if west_stats is None or east_stats is None: print("SO2 calculation failed.") print("C3") elif west_count == 0 and east_count == 0: print("No valid pixels in either region.") print("C2") elif west_stats > east_stats and west_stats > 0: print("Plume detected on western side.") print("A") else: print("No significant westward plume.") print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
etna = ee.Geometry.Point([15.00, 37.75])
target_date = '2021-02-23'

# Create regions: west and east of the volcano
west_region = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[14.85, 37.65], [14.85, 37.85], [15.00, 37.85], [15.00, 37.65], [14.85, 37.65]]
])
east_region = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[15.00, 37.65], [15.00, 37.85], [15.15, 37.85], [15.15, 37.65], [15.00, 37.65]]
])

# 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-5P SO2
col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_SO2') \
    .filterDate(target_date, '2021-02-24') \
    .filterBounds(etna)

print(f"Images found: {col.size().getInfo()}")

if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No Sentinel-5P data for this date.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Get SO2 data
    img = col.first()
    so2_band = img.select('SO2_column_number_density')
    
    # 4. Calculate mean SO2 in west and east regions
    west_stats = so2_band.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=west_region,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    
    east_stats = so2_band.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=east_region,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    
    # Check pixel counts
    west_count = so2_band.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=west_region,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    
    east_count = so2_band.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=east_region,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    
    print(f"West SO2: {west_stats}, Pixels: {west_count}")
    print(f"East SO2: {east_stats}, Pixels: {east_count}")
    
    # 5. Validation & Answer
    if west_stats is None or east_stats is None:
        print("SO2 calculation failed.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif west_count == 0 and east_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels in either region.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif west_stats > east_stats and west_stats > 0:
        print("Plume detected on western side.")
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("No significant westward plume.")
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
